name: RockRobin
source:
Robin is kicked out of her band by her former lover! She must start a new band to show them up. Her fellow band-members aren't exactly who she thought she would be working with ... But she needs them, for now anyway!

The game is half visual novel, half band management sim.

Customize your own band by choosing your genre, name, and logo. You give your band members tasks to practice in the week, raising 3 stats and generating stress: Music, Writing, and Star Quality. You play gigs to earn Popularity, which is the goal of the game: to get really popular.

The game is split into two modes: Story Mode and Open-Ended Mode. During Story Mode, you will have 3 non-adjustable band members. After the story ends, you can form any kind of band you want and recruit who you wish. Story Mode is mostly linear so it can tell a strong story.
translation:
罗宾被前恋人踢出乐队！为了让那群人刮目相看，她必须另组一支新乐队。新队友与自己设想的人选相去甚远……但至少现在，她还离不开他们！

本作一半是视觉小说，一半是乐队经营模拟游戏。

玩家可以选择音乐类型、名称和标志，定制自己的乐队。每周为团员安排练习任务，提升音乐、创作与明星气质3项能力，同时也会积累压力。参加演出能够提高人气，而成为真正大受欢迎的乐队，正是游戏的最终目标。

游戏分为故事模式与开放模式。故事模式中有3名无法更换的固定团员；剧情结束后，玩家可以自由组建任何类型的乐队，招募心仪成员。为保证叙事效果，故事模式大体采用线性流程。
